title: Monitor Me — Fleet Overview
description: Provisioned overview of host telemetry stored by Monitor Me. Select one or more enrolled servers to compare CPU, memory, network and disk throughput.

list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM servers ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts.observed_at, '$__interval'), s.name AS metric, avg(ts.value) AS value FROM telemetry_samples ts JOIN servers s ON s.id = ts.server_id AND s.organization_id = ts.organization_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ts.observed_at) AND ts.metric_name = 'host.cpu.utilization' AND ('${server:raw}' = 'All' OR ts.server_id::text IN (${server:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts.observed_at, '$__interval'), s.name AS metric, avg(ts.value) AS value FROM telemetry_samples ts JOIN servers s ON s.id = ts.server_id AND s.organization_id = ts.organization_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ts.observed_at) AND ts.metric_name = 'host.memory.used' AND ('${server:raw}' = 'All' OR ts.server_id::text IN (${server:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent host telemetry samples
panels.description: Raw recent samples with metric names, values, units and source server.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts.observed_at AS time, s.name AS server, ts.metric_name, ts.value, ts.unit, ts.labels FROM telemetry_samples ts JOIN servers s ON s.id = ts.server_id AND s.organization_id = ts.organization_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ts.observed_at) AND ('${server:raw}' = 'All' OR ts.server_id::text IN (${server:sqlstring})) ORDER BY ts.observed_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Host logs
panels.description: Native Linux journald and supported host log events collected by Monitor Me and stored in ClickHouse.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS timestamp, body, severity AS level, source, toString(server_id) AS server_id, event_id AS id, attributes AS labels FROM monitor_me.logs WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${server:raw}' = 'All' OR toString(server_id) IN (${server:sqlstring})) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1000
